beta.label: beta (biodegradability)
beta.note: multiplies the degradable fraction; a purely multiplicative ceiling change

eta_lcfa.label: eta (LCFA partition)
eta_lcfa.note: fraction of lipid appearing as inhibitory LCFA

k_ref.label: k_ref
k_ref.note: first-order rate constant; changes how much of the ceiling the window completes

lcfa_half.label: LCFA half-saturation
lcfa_half.note: concentration at which the LCFA penalty halves; never resolved by the sources

missingness.label: missingness rate
missingness.note: the specification prints a single rate, while the frozen simulator carries two (2 % for pH and 1.5 % for temperature). The nominal level therefore keeps the simulator's pair, so that a delta of exactly zero is measurable, and the 0 % / 5 % levels set both rates. This wording gap is recorded rather than resolved silently

pretreatment_response.label: pre-treatment response distribution
pretreatment_response.note: the whole point of Q2: the response distribution is swept, never assumed beneficial

sigma_t_meso.label: sigma_T mesophilic
sigma_t_meso.note: width of the mesophilic temperature optimum

tan_half.label: TAN half-saturation
tan_half.note: the ammonia threshold spread is carried rather than resolved

ts_shape.label: TS shape
ts_shape.note: the total-solids direction is contested (claim C-005); this is where it is probed

caveat: These numbers describe how sensitive the SIMULATOR is to its own assumptions. They are not measurements, they do not transfer to real food waste or real digesters, and a small sensitivity here means the assumption matters little *in this model*, not that it is unimportant in reality.
nothing_else_swept: Exactly the ten assumptions of SPEC_V1 11 were swept, three pre-declared levels each. No other constant, structural choice or analysis option was varied, which is what makes the sweep reproducible rather than exploratory.
sweep_scale_note: Each sweep row re-runs generate -> fit -> optimise under one changed assumption at the sweep configuration recorded in this metadata. That configuration is a runtime choice and is not the study configuration: the sweep measures the sign and rough size of each effect, not its precise value at study size.
